title: Create Existing-Capability Stress Level
objective: Design and create levels/restroom_003.json as a sprawling, intentional neon restroom labyrinth using only the target repository's currently enabled data-driven level capabilities and no runtime changes.
acceptance: restroom_003 passes the trusted TB-003 loader, complexity, runtime, gameplay, regression, screenshot, Linux export, and exported-runtime gate
the level contains four visually distinct spatial zones, meaningful branching, two deliberate decoy/dead-end concepts, a central transition, and two small surprises
10–16 toilets include at least 6 collectibles and at least 3 deliberate empty-toilet decoys, with objective count equal to collectibles
30–70 box primitives, 6–14 labels, and 6–12 lights with at least 3 light colors form an intentional ground-traversable level
no source file other than levels/restroom_003.json changes and no gameplay capability or schema field is added
